rationale: Post-contingency state with l13 out has l12 overloaded at 133.3% (100 MW > 75 MW rating). Among the 4 candidate switches, only closing l14 provides a feasible solution with all branches within ratings (max loading 94.3% on l12). Opening any branch (l23, l24, or l34) results in overloads on remaining branches. Closing the tie line l14 provides an alternative path from b1 to b4, reducing flow on the heavily loaded l12.
